name: Gossby Positive Crochet Sunflower Doll with Card
metaDescription: A small crochet sunflower doll with an encouraging card, a sweet thank you for a nurse or coworker. Easy to set on a locker shelf or desk at the station.
summary: A cheerful crochet sunflower with an encouraging note is a soft, simple thank you that a nurse can keep on a desk, locker, or bedside table.
whyItWorks: Some of the best nurse gifts are not useful at all, they are just kind. After a rough run of shifts, a little sunflower that comes with a reminder to keep going can land harder than another gadget. Sunflowers already carry a feeling of warmth and hope, and the crochet look gives it a handmade, cozy charm.

It is especially fitting as a thank you from a patient's family to the nurse who got them through a hospital stay. It also works between coworkers, a quiet way to tell someone on your unit you see how hard they are working. Because it is small, it fits on a charting desk, a locker shelf, or the dashboard of a car, so it stays visible. For Nurses Week, a manager could pick up a few for the team. Include your own handwritten line alongside the included card to make it feel even more personal.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for the exact wording on the card so it matches the message you want to send.
It is decor, not a practical tool, so pair it with coffee or snacks if you want a useful element too.
Small enough to mail in a padded envelope to a nurse friend far away.

faq.q: Is this an appropriate gift from a patient's family?
faq.a: Yes. It is modest, personal, and easy for a nurse to accept, which makes it a nice way to say thank you after a hospital stay.

faq.q: Is it too sentimental for a coworker?
faq.a: Not really. It reads as encouraging rather than romantic, so it suits a work friend, a preceptor, or a whole unit for Nurses Week.
